title: Schengen Visa — German Embassy Belgrade

visa_eligibility.serbian_citizens: Travel visa-free to Schengen countries for up to 90 days within 180 days for tourism, family visits, business, or medical treatment.
visa_eligibility.other_nationals: May require a Schengen visa for short stays. Eligibility depends on nationality.

processing_times.note_russian_passports: Processing extended to 45 days for Russian passport holders.
processing_times.important: Applications cannot be accepted if planned trip starts within less than 15 calendar days.

application_location.booking: Appointments booked via Visametric website only. Direct submission to the consulate is not possible.

fee_exemptions: Spouses and minor children of German/EU citizens

required_documents_all_applicants: Two biometric passport photos (not older than 6 months)
Passport valid for at least 6 months after the planned travel; not older than 10 years
Travel health insurance with minimum coverage of 30,000 EUR
Bank statements for the last 3 months (stamped)
additional_documents_non_serbian_residen: Valid residence permit for Serbia (original and copy)

documents_for_minors.note: Individual applications are mandatory for all minors under 18.

family_or_private_visit: Formal obligation per §§ 66–68 of the German Residence Act (Verpflichtungserklärung) confirmed by the local German Aliens Authority, or invitation letter with proof of sufficient funds
medical_treatment: Medical institution documentation confirming illness, treatment duration, and cost pre-payment
airport_transit: Valid entry permit for the destination country

special_provisions_russian_passport_hold.visa_type: Single-entry only (family visit exceptions may apply)
special_provisions_russian_passport_hold.financial_documents: Russian financial documents are not accepted
special_provisions_russian_passport_hold.employment_note: If the applicant left Russia after 2022, employment records from outside Russia are required

employees: CROSO printout (Central Register of Compulsory Social Insurance)

contact_and_resources.german_federal_foreign_office: Check visa requirements by nationality on the official website
